articles.title: Macron addresses Ukraine, Greenland at NATO summit
articles.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron told reporters at the NATO summit that he does not believe the US would seize Greenland, while also addressing the war in Ukraine and Iran.

articles.title: Macron in Syria on first post-Assad visit by West European head of state
articles.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron arrived in Damascus for the first visit by a Western European head of state since Syria's new authorities took power, meeting with President Ahmed al-Sharaa to reaffirm France's commitment to Syria and discuss reconstruction and investments.

articles.title: Macron's 'Versailles diplomacy' yields mixed results after a decade in power
articles.summary: Analysis of French President Emmanuel Macron's diplomatic strategy using the Palace of Versailles as a soft-power tool, examining successes and failures in translating grand gestures into lasting strategic influence during his tenure.

articles.title: 'For sure': Macron to preach stronger Europe vision at G7 swansong
articles.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron hosts his last G7 summit as president, pushing his vision of a stronger, more autonomous Europe amid concerns about US protectionism and NATO commitments under Trump's administration.

articles.title: Replay: French President Emmanuel Macron speaks after Damascus blasts
articles.summary: Video replay of French President Emmanuel Macron's press conference with Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa during his landmark visit to Damascus, conducted after two bombs exploded near Macron's hotel.
